subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I am _________ busy.
solution:
The correct answer is '**quite**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**quite**" means to a certain or significant extent. (काफी)
 
• It is used to indicate the degree or extent of something.
 
• The other options: "**few**," "**quiet**," and "**tidily**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I am quite__ busy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Few (कुछ)**: means a small number of.
 
• **Quiet (शांत)**: means making little or no noise.
 
• **Tidily (साफ-सुथरा)**: means in a neat and orderly manner.
